content.question: What does the self-attention mechanism allow the Transformer to do?
options: Let each word attend only to a fixed window of nearby words, keeping the attention computation strictly local.
Process the sequence one time step at a time, carrying information forward through a hidden memory.
Let each word attend to all other words with weights computed from their relevance, capturing dependencies at any distance.
Compress the whole sequence into a single fixed-size vector before passing it on to the decoder.
Let each word attend to all others with equal, unlearned weights so the context is just their average.
content.answer: Let each word attend to all other words with weights computed from their relevance, capturing dependencies at any distance.
